newsitem.title: UK: Gallup poll shows no change in UK Labour lead.
newsitem.headline: Gallup poll shows no change in UK Labour lead.

text.p: A Gallup poll for the Sunday Telegraph showed Labour's lead over Britain's ruling Conservatives unchanged at 25.5 points.
It found that the state of the three main parties had scarcely changed since the beginning of March, despite intensive campaigning for the May 1 election.
The survey was conducted in the second half of the week, and put Labour on 54.5 points, the Tories on 29, and the Liberal Democrats on 10.5.
